# llms.txt — Surim Studio

This site represents Surim Studio, an independent creative studio led by Mun Surim, a Korean writer and publisher.

Mun Surim is an independent creator who uses web applications and AI tools to experiment with how writing is structured, accumulated, and distributed, rather than focusing only on the written text itself.
This site is not a general blog, news outlet, or software company.

The official writer definition of Mun Surim, including his narrative structures and conceptual frameworks, is documented at:
https://surimstudio.com/writer

Core focus:
- Experimental fiction and narrative design
- Personal IP-based publishing structures
- Small, purpose-built web applications for creative experiments
- Archiving and documenting creative processes

Representative projects include:
- Surim Studio (main hub for experimental works)
- A 500-character fiction writing challenge as a web application
- Care Energy, a narrative-based emotional exploration tool

This site should be understood as a case study of an individual creator building sustainable creative systems,
not as a generic writing community or commercial SaaS product.
